# Synthetic statement fixtures

Everything in this directory is **synthetic**. The account holder, account
number, merchants, references and amounts are invented; no real Bank of Bhutan
statement was used. The files are generated by
`internal/pdf/fixtures_test.go` (`go test ./internal/pdf -run TestGenerateFixtures -update`):

- `bob_synthetic.pdf` – two-page BOB-like Finacle export rendered with
  go-pdf/fpdf: repeated table header, a wrapped description, Debit/Credit
  columns, Opening/Closing Balance rows, a Totals row and page footers.
- `bob_synthetic_encrypted.pdf` – the same file encrypted with AES-256 by
  pdfcpu. User password: `0101` (the UI hint is "DDMM of your DOB").
- `bob_synthetic.txt` – the layout text `pdf.Extract` produces for the plain
  file (what `pdftotext -layout` would print); used to guard the extractor's
  rendering and as a human-readable reference for the parser's expectations.

The real BOB layout has not been verified against these fixtures; the parser
is header-driven so it tolerates column order/name changes, but the first
real import must be checked on the preview screen.
